runs.name: A1-plan-scout-work
runs.task: Refactor scripts/game_scene.gd (1635 lines). It is a monolithic file mixing input handling, piece logic, board state, scoring, and UI updates. Split it into focused modules: extract piece movement and rotation into a dedicated PieceController, extract board state and line-clear logic into a BoardManager, and reduce game_scene.gd to a thin coordinator that wires them together. Keep all existing behaviour identical — no feature changes. Each extracted class should be in its own file under scripts/.
